column7: machineRestrictionFrom read a machine credential whose stored AllowedCIDRs is null or [] as no restriction, so the auth middleware skipped the CIDR check and an IP-pinned machine token worked from any address (IssueMachineToken stores an empty column for no restriction, so such a row is corrupted or hand-edited). It now decodes through rules.DecodePATCIDRs like the PAT path: a non-empty column that names no CIDR (bad JSON, null, [], a blank entry) is the sentinel no source IP matches. Refused at the middleware on the validation path and on the cache-hit re-check. Unit: internal/core TestMachineRestrictionFrom_ColumnNamingNoCIDRFailsClosed.
